stages.discovery: Smoke and chanting drift from a clearing off the trail, underscored by the crackle of torches at unnatural hours.

choices.label: Scout the Clearing First
choices.description: Get a look before moving in
choices.outcome: Robed figures kneel in a ring around a crude stone altar, torches guttering despite the still air.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - leave it be

stages.ignore: You leave the chanting behind and keep to the trail.

stages.discovery: The chanting rises to a fever pitch. At the altar's center, a bound figure struggles weakly against their restraints.

choices.label: Move In Before It's Too Late
Count Their Numbers First
choices.description: Get a sense of what you're facing
choices.outcome: You count robed cultists ringing the altar, along with darker shapes stirring restlessly at the circle's edge - summoned, not sworn.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - turn back now

stages.ignore: You back away and leave the ritual to run its course.

stages.discovery: Cloaked cultists chant around a bound figure atop a crude stone altar.
stages.sneak_success: You creep close enough to catch the ritual's final words before a cultist notices movement at the treeline.
stages.sneak_fail: One of the cultists looks up mid-chant and points a bony finger straight at you.
stages.ignore: You back away quietly, leaving the ritual to whatever dark end it's building toward.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Walk in and see what's happening

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Stealth check to glimpse it unseen

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking

victim_data.dialogue: Please... cut me loose before they finish the chant...
thanks: Free at last... here, take this - it's the least I can offer.
I thought I was done for. Please, take this for saving me.
after: Thank you again, adventurer. I'll not forget this.

aftermath.discovery: The cultists are dead. The figure on the altar is alive, but barely - and terrified.

choices.label: Escort Them to the Wardens
choices.description: See them safely into the Wardens' protection
choices.outcome: You help the captive down from the altar. Still shaking, they cling close and follow your lead toward the nearest inn, where the Wardens can be sent for once they're safe.

choices.label: Cut Them Loose
choices.description: Free them and let them find their own way
choices.outcome: You cut the bindings and help them to their feet. They stumble off into the dark without looking back, too shaken to say anything.

choices.label: Leave the Altar Behind
choices.description: ESC also cancels - the ritual is stopped, that's enough
choices.outcome: You leave the altar and its captive behind, telling yourself stopping the ritual was enough for one night.
